description: This file defines a React functional component 'TodoApp' implementing a To-Do list application with persistence to localStorage and styling themed as 'Ocean Professional'. It includes task management features like adding, toggling, deleting tasks, and loading/saving tasks across sessions.

methods.name: getLocalStorage
methods.description: Returns localStorage-like object if available, else null

methods.name: getCrypto
methods.description: Returns crypto object if available, else null

methods.name: createId
methods.description: Generates unique ID for tasks using crypto if available, fallback to timestamp and random string

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the task list

methods.name: toggleTask
methods.description: Toggles completion status of a task by ID
